cleanup.notes: Delete starter/target to remove compiled classes and test reports. The tests start the app on a free localhost port and stop it again; nothing else is written. Setup also downloads Javalin, its dependencies, JUnit and the pinned Maven plugins into the learner's local Maven repository (~/.m2/repository by default); that shared cache is kept for later Java labs and is not removed by cleanup.

licensing: Starter, tests and README: original work for this repository.
